Download the installer for your platform below.

**macOS:** download the signed + notarized universal `ChatOSS_<version>_universal.dmg` — one build that runs natively on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs — built and uploaded from a developer machine with the Apple Developer ID certificate.
**Windows:** ChatOSS_*_x64-setup.exe
**Linux:** ChatOSS_*_amd64.AppImage or .deb


## What is new in v1.31.4

- **Compact now works on one giant message.** Paste a huge block of text (hundreds of thousands of tokens) and "Compact" / `/compact` used to say the chat was "too short". A single message over 200k tokens can now be summarized on its own — even when it is the newest message — so you can carry on chatting without that paste being replayed in full on every turn. The full transcript is untouched, and Stop now cancels a summarization that is in progress.
- **Typing no longer pushes the reply behind the input.** With a tall input and the conversation scrolled to the bottom, typing used to slide the end of the reply under the input and flash the scroll-to-bottom button. The reply now stays put as the input grows, shrinks or fills up — in Chat, Kanban, Code, Models and Connect.
- **Attached images enlarge everywhere.** Click an attached image in the Chat or Kanban input (and in the edit-message box) to view it full screen, just like Code. Closing the full-screen view no longer discards a message you were editing.
- **Kanban's input opens one row tall.** It could open at full height with nothing typed, after the chat column had been collapsed. It now always starts small and re-fits when the pane is resized.
